sources.title: KSRSAC Bengaluru Urban flooding locations - 3 KSRSAC datasets (via OpenCity)
sources.license: Public Domain per OpenCity CKAN metadata (no upstream dedication)

provenance.note: KSRSAC KML download + conversion; the conversion run itself is unrecorded (the _meta block, not a committed script, is the production record). Three KSRSAC categories - 70 named flood-prone, 194 unnamed vulnerability points, 128 named low-lying areas; see _meta.categories for the distinctions and the named-locality RTI follow-up.

_meta.source: Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre (KSRSAC), via OpenCity

categories.named_flood_prone: 70 named localities BBMP classifies as flood-prone (e.g. Bhadrappa Layout, Sampangirama Nagar). Curated list, generally hotspots with documented flooding history.
categories.vulnerable_unnamed: 194 unnamed points from KSRSAC's broader vulnerability assessment - typically low-elevation pixels in valleys. Unnamed in the upstream KML; named-locality cross-reference is a follow-up RTI to BBMP.
categories.named_low_lying: 128 named low-lying areas (e.g. JRD Tata Nagar, Devi Nagara). Overlaps geographically with flood-prone in many cases but is a distinct KSRSAC dataset.
